name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](http://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2017-10-25.124.1) to agree with the [bill](http://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/s1042) as amended. This vote ends the [consideration in detail](https://www.peo.gov.au/learning/fact-sheets/making-a-law.html) stage of the bill and means that the House can now decide on whether they want to pass the bill so it can become law. ### What does this bill do? The bill creates mandatory minimum sentences and increases maximum penalties for the offences of trafficking firearms or parts of firearms both within Australia and between Australia and the rest of the world. Read the [bills digest](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd1617a/17bd029) for more information.
